ownership: Package-authored oral materials are the exact reset state. Mutable color, brightness, and shine values live only in the Goon's Oral Appearance sibling.
defaultLaw: Null state and the generated default state reproduce the package-authored material color factors and roughness exactly.
customTexturePolicy: No user texture upload is accepted by v1. Gum and tongue remain color-only; custom teeth textures require a future template, validation, and asset lifecycle.
